findings.title: Cleanup registers removal of literal alias "alias" instead of the created IDP
findings.body: In testCacheIDPForLogin, the loop that creates 20 IDPs registers cleanup with getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove) — the string "alias" is a literal, not the loop variable alias ("idp-alias-" + i). The same mistake is repeated at line 425 for "idp-alias-20". As a result the cleanup removes a non-existent IDP named "alias" and the 20+ created identity providers leak into subsequent tests in the class (e.g. testCacheIDPByOrg counts IDPs and can see these leftover brokers), making tests order-dependent and flaky.

findings.title: Login IDP cache is not invalidated when an organization is removed or disabled
findings.body: getForLogin caches IDP id sets per (FetchMode, organizationId), but unlike getByOrganization it never checks isInvalid(orgId), and no invalidation of the cacheKeyForLogin keys is registered when an organization is removed, disabled, or when an IDP is linked/unlinked through the organization API without going through IdentityProviderStorageProvider.update() (the invalidation in registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate only fires on the update() path and relies on the caller passing an updated model with the new organizationId). If an org is deleted or its broker link is changed outside update(), the cached ORG_ONLY/ALL login lists keep returning the old IDP ids, so the login page can show brokers for a removed/disabled organization until the entry is evicted. getByOrganization handles this exact case with the isInvalid(orgId) check; getForLogin should do the same (or org removal/unlink should register invalidation for all login cache keys).
